question: The drainage basin of the Godavari river is present in which of the following states of India?

options.text: Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu
Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, and Odisha
Chhattisgarh, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu
Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Odisha

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, and Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Godavari** river's drainage basin is spread across several Indian states, including **Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, and Odisha**.
 
• It is the **second longest river** in India after the Ganga, spanning a length of about **1465 kilometers**.
 
• The Godavari River is also known as the **"Dakshina Ganga"** or **"Southern Ganges"** due to its importance and size, which rivals that of the Ganges in the north.
 
• Its drainage basin is one of the **largest** in India, covering an area of approximately **312,812 square kilometers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Feature
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Source
 The river originates from Triambakeshwar, Maharashtra.
 
 

 Tributaries
 Major tributaries include Pranhita, Indravati, Manjira, and Sabari.
 
 

 Significance
 It supports a large ecosystem with its basin, including flora, fauna, and human settlements.
 
 

 Religious Importance
 The river is considered sacred and hosts the Kumbh Mela every twelve years in Nashik.
 
 

 Hydroelectric Projects
 It houses several hydroelectric and irrigation projects, including the Polavaram Project.
